title: [IMP-29] No list of spec-defined type URIs, DID service types or exporter labels
description: Review finding IMP-29: No list of spec-defined type URIs, DID service types or exporter labels (lens IMP). Location: spec/07-compliance.md:227; spec/04-access-control.md:127; spec/05-messaging.md:283-301; spec/13-encoding.md:32, :100 (not :164). Fix: Mostly resolved by existing rules. 13:32 says "An Agora protocol type is named `urn:agora:type:` followed by the type name", which fixes the URNs for `ComplianceDisclosureNotice` and `DMGroupDescriptor`. 05:261 admits "a type defined in another section", and 06:422 defines the call-type naming. The service-type mismatch is IMP-8. Mixed exporter-label styles are each exact strings and cause no divergence. What remains: write the full URN at 07:227 and 04:145 for clarity, and define the `SystemEvent.event` values (only one example exists, at 09:185). An appendix index is optional. Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
